title: [GMCP 203.003.06] Operations and evidence: Modern stateless lifecycle and server discovery
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-003-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: For MCP 2026-07-28 and later GMCP is genuinely stateless at the protocol layer: no initialize ceremony or session identifier is required, every request carries and validates version plus client capabilities, every result identifies the server, server/discover is complete and cacheable, and explicit handles bind all cross-call state. Concurrent requests from changing clients cannot leak negotiated state. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
